items.title: Native lint and typecheck Deployment Checks are being deprecated
items.summary: Native lint and typecheck  are being deprecated. Use  or your own CI workflows to continue running these tasks.Deployment ChecksVercel CIThese checks run your repository’s lint and typecheck tasks on Vercel in parallel with deployment builds. New checks can no longer be added. Existing checks continue running until November 30, 2026,  when they’re removed.Other Deployment Checks and commands already running in GitHub Actions or your Build Command are unaffected.Affected checks appear as  or  entries with  as the provider in your project’s . Move their commands before removal. For checks that block production releases, verify how the new workflow handles failures.LintTypecheckVercelBuild and Deployment settingsYou can also run these commands in your Build Command, though that may increase build time and an error will fail the deployment build.Try this prompt to ask your coding agent to help migrate your lint and typecheck tasks to Vercel CI:Read the  to learn more.Vercel CI documentationRead moreWhat this meansHow to migrate
